name: Palette Texture Volume Rendering
aliases: Adaptive Screen-Resolution Rendering with Palette Textures
Mobile volume visualization using palette textures
definition: An approach for accelerating 2D slicing volume visualization on mobile devices by using adaptive screen-resolution rendering, compressed palette textures, and basic graphics hardware functionality (rasterization and 2D texture mapping).
summary: Palette Texture Volume Rendering accelerates mobile volume visualization by using 8-bit indexed palette textures and a luminance-based heuristic for adaptive resolution scaling.
